# FG-GIT-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`push-record-failed`](../../ops/runbooks/push-record-failed.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_push_that_cannot_be_recorded_is_push_record_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プッシュは反映されましたが、その記録を保存できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The push was applied, but its record could not be saved. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Push sudah diterapkan, tetapi catatannya tidak dapat disimpan. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

git updated the refs of a push (outside any database transaction, ADR-0008), but the `repository.pushed` audit row and event could not be written afterwards (reason `record_failed`: forge_db::repositories::record_push failed on every attempt — the database was unreachable or slow, see `cause_code`). The repository is correct; only the audit trail and the integration feed (kanflow, webhooks) miss this push until it is replayed. Also: `forge admin repo record-push --from-log` could not use the log it was given (reason `push_log_invalid` with `field`, `push_log_empty`, `push_log_unreadable`, `push_log_too_large`): the push is still not recorded.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `repo_id`, `refs` (updates in the push), `attempts`, `cause_code` (the code of the last failure: FG-DB-0001 unreachable, FG-DB-0002 query failed or timed out, FG-DB-0010 the record was refused) and the push's `request_id`. The same request id has one earlier `event=forge.git.push_applied` line (info) with the full ref list in `push`: that line is the replay input. Check the database first (forge doctor, runbook db-unavailable). For push_log_*: `field` names the part of the line that did not parse (the value is not logged).

## 対処 (fix)

Once the database is healthy, replay the push from its log line as an approved runbook step: extract the `forge.git.push_applied` line(s) of the request id into a file and run `forge admin repo record-push --from-log <file>`. The replay is idempotent (the dedup key is built from the logged request id and the updates): a push that was in fact recorded is reported as already recorded. Never write audit rows or events by hand.
